mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained), the market anticipates reduced corporate borrowing and lower economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by rising employment (PAYEMS), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate labor data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a stagflationary environment where supply constraints and rising prices erode corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market prices in an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
